meta.name: The Aam Aadmi Family Season 1
meta.description: This show revolves around a middle-class Sharma family. There's a gossip-loving grandmother, a hardworking father, a sanskaari mom, and two grown up kids who are dealing with their middle-classness in the best way possible.

videos.title: Deewar
videos.overview: The TV is finally delivered. But, there's one last decision to be made.

videos.title: Naya Daur
videos.overview: Will Sonu be able to convince her Mom to wear jeans?

videos.title: Badhaai Ho Badhaai
videos.overview: Sonu breaks up with her boyfriend and ends up accepting an arranged marriage proposal. But things do not go as planned.

videos.title: Jhooth Bole Kauwa Kaate
videos.overview: Mr Sharma arrives home early from the office on the pretext of being unwell, but is he really ill?
